text:
lin: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to consolidate the triage steps that tripped during the ml-runtime outage. Specific asks: 1) single triage checklist, 2) clear escalation path, 3) owners + deadlines. Who can take lead?

andre: I can own the triage checklist consolidation. Will PR to /runbooks/runtime by Fri EOD. Planning to fold in `cache-eviction` and `model-fallback` steps.

sarah: I'll update escalation matrix (who gets paged at what threshold). Add paging rule for "latency spike > 200ms p95 for 10m" -> oncall -> infra -> eng-runtime.

devon: Can we add a quick command snippet for rolling back model variants? Put this in the runbook:
```
# rollback to baseline
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service runtime --model-version v1.4.2
```

andre: +1. Also adding KV cache sanity checks:
```
# quick KV cache dump
redis-cli -h kv-host-1 INFO memory
# delete prefix
redis-cli -h kv-host-1 EVAL "redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])" 1 "prefix:*"
```

incident-bot: Note: next oncall rotation starts 2024-12-01. Add contact links.

lin: Owners + timelines: Andre -> triage checklist PR (due Fri), Sarah -> escalation matrix updates (due Tue), Devon -> rollback & KV snippets + test run (due Wed). I'll own validation and schedule a 30m runbook review on Thu 10:00am PT.

andre: Filing PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/842 (draft)

sarah: Updated pager entries in the draft doc, pinged @ops-oncall for review.

devon: I did a dry-run of rollback on staging. Notes: needs `--force` if model artifacts missing. I'll add that caveat.

lin: Recurring pattern detection: note that the last 3 outages had cache thrash after heavy embedding traffic. Proposal: add automated cache eviction check into triage and run a scheduled job to preemptively trim caches when embedding QPS > 1200. @andre can you add the metric and alert?

andre: Yep, adding a `cache_thrash` alert to metrics: `sum(rate(embedding_requests[5m])) by (pod) > 1200` -> alert -> page infra team. Will link alert rule in PR.

sarah: Suggest adding a short "when to escalate to SRE" section: include `>=3 node restarts in 1h` and `model fallback failed` as triggers.

lin: Thanks all. Action tracker: I'll create an issue with the list and owners, will update status there. Follow-up check-in next Wed 09:00 PT. If anyone wants the slot earlier, ping me.

andre: small note — add a "how to collect traces" snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://tracing.internal/collect -d '{"trace_id":"$TRACE_ID"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

devon: Added unit test to simulate cache eviction in runtime tests, PR incoming.

lin: Closing loop: once PRs merged, we bump runbook version, add to release notes, and run a 15m tabletop with oncall. Thanks :thumbsup:
